questions.stem: 許多人過世時沒有留下社群帳號的密碼，使家人無法找回最珍貴的回憶。
questions.answer: Many people die without leaving the passwords to their social media accounts, preventing their families from recovering their most precious memories.
accepted_answers: Many people pass away without leaving behind the passwords for their social media accounts, making it impossible for their families to get back their most precious memories.
Many people die without leaving their social media passwords behind, leaving their families unable to recover their most treasured memories.

questions.stem: 因此，指定一位可靠的人管理數位遺產（digital legacy），應該被視為立遺囑不可或缺的一環。
questions.answer: Therefore, appointing a reliable person to manage one's digital legacy should be regarded as an essential part of making a will.
accepted_answers: Thus, choosing someone reliable to take care of your digital legacy should be seen as a necessary part of writing a will.
Hence, naming a trustworthy person to handle one's digital legacy should be viewed as a vital part of drawing up a will.

1.explanation_zh: 「過世時沒有留下…」英文寫成 die（或 pass away）without leaving …，without 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 leaving；「社群帳號的密碼」是 the passwords to／for their social media accounts，也可以濃縮成 their social media passwords，「社群」不要譯成 community。「使家人無法找回…」說的是前面整件事造成的結果，用句尾分詞 preventing their families from recovering …，或 leaving their families unable to recover …；prevent 要配 from + V-ing。「最珍貴的回憶」用最高級 their most precious memories。
evidence: 沒有留下社群帳號的密碼
使家人無法找回最珍貴的回憶
1.strategy_zh: 前半是事實、後半是結果時，先寫完整的主要子句，再用逗號＋V-ing 接結果；看到「最…的」就檢查有沒有寫出 the／their most＋形容詞。
hints: 切成四段：許多人過世時／沒有留下社群帳號的密碼／使家人無法找回／最珍貴的回憶
標的詞彙：die（過世，也可用 pass away）、leave（留下）、password（密碼）、social media（社群媒體）、family（家人）、recover（找回）、precious（珍貴的）、memory（回憶）
句型框架：S + die without V-ing …, preventing + O + from V-ing + their most + adj. + N

2.explanation_zh: 「指定一位可靠的人管理數位遺產」是一個動作，當主詞時用動名詞片語 Appointing a reliable person to manage one's digital legacy（appoint + 人 + to VR），後面動詞用單數。「應該被視為」用被動 should be regarded／seen as；「立遺囑」是 make／write a will，「不可或缺的一環」是 an essential／indispensable part。
evidence: 指定一位可靠的人管理數位遺產
2.strategy_zh: 中文主詞是一件事時，英文先想動名詞主詞；看到「被視為」直接套 be regarded as。
hints: 切成四段：因此，指定一位可靠的人／管理數位遺產／應該被視為／立遺囑不可或缺的一環
標的詞彙：appoint（指定）、reliable（可靠的）、manage（管理）、regard（視為）、essential（不可或缺的）、part（一環）、will（遺囑）
句型框架：Therefore, V-ing + O + to VR … + should be regarded as + an essential part of + V-ing

traps.literal_error: Many people die without leaving the passwords of their community accounts, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「社群帳號」是複合概念，指社群媒體帳號 social media accounts；照字面把「社群」譯成 community 意思就錯了。

traps.explanation_zh: 照中文語序寫 makes their families cannot … 會變成一句兩個動詞；表結果要用句尾分詞 preventing … from V-ing。

bonus.text: Many people pass away without leaving their passwords behind, only to leave their families locked out of their most cherished memories.
bonus.explanation_zh: only to + VR 表示出乎意料、令人遺憾的結果；be locked out of 生動地描寫「被擋在外面、進不去」。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「許多人過世時沒有留下…」不必譯出「時」，英文用 die without + V-ing 一氣呵成；「使家人無法找回…」承接前面整件事，不另起一句，用句尾分詞 preventing … from V-ing（或 leaving … unable to VR）表結果。
1.notes_zh: 本句的標的句型是句尾分詞表結果；「使家人無法找回」寫成非限定關係子句 , which prevents／leaves … 或 , which means (that) their families cannot … 也表達同一個「前面整件事造成的結果」，一併算作第 3 部分與 PART 的可接受寫法（第 3 部分 accepted 已列出）。寫成 so their families cannot … 是對等子句，沒有用到標的句型，不在可接受寫法內。「最珍貴的回憶」單複數都可以，習慣用複數 memories；第 1 部分寫 When many people die 時，第 2 部分接 they do not leave …。

traps.zh: 指定一位可靠的人管理數位遺產
traps.literal_error: Therefore, appoint a reliable person to manage one's digital legacy should be regarded as …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接用「指定…管理…」這個動作當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Appointing …（或不定詞 To appoint …），否則一句會有兩個主要動詞。

traps.literal_error: an essential part of standing a will
traps.explanation_zh: 「立遺囑」的搭配是 make／write／draw up a will，照字面把「立」譯成 stand、set 都不對。

bonus.text: Making a will should never be considered complete until a reliable person has been appointed to manage one's digital legacy.
bonus.explanation_zh: 改用 never … until …（直到…才算）從反面強調「不可或缺」，並把「指定管理人」寫成完成式被動 has been appointed。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文以「指定一位可靠的人管理數位遺產」這個動作當主題，英文改成動名詞主詞 Appointing a reliable person to manage …（appoint + 人 + to VR），動詞用單數；「應該被視為」用被動 should be regarded as；「不可或缺的一環」寫 an essential／indispensable part。
2.notes_zh: 第 1 部分的動名詞主詞也可以寫成不定詞 To appoint …（同樣是 NFSUBJ）。寫成 People should regard appointing … as … 是主動句，沒有用到被動，不在可接受寫法內。「可靠的人」寫成 someone you can trust 也可以；「數位遺產」題目已附 digital legacy，所有格 one's／your／their 都可以。

1.translation: Many people pass away without leaving behind the passwords to their social media accounts, making it impossible for their families to retrieve their most precious memories.
1.explanation_zh: 「過世時沒有留下」用 pass away without leaving behind 表達；「使家人無法…」用分詞構句 making it impossible for … to … 承接前句結果，「找回」用 retrieve。

2.translation: Therefore, appointing a reliable person to manage one's digital legacy should be regarded as an indispensable part of making a will.
2.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語 appointing … 當主詞；「應該被視為」用 should be regarded as；「不可或缺的一環」譯 an indispensable part，「立遺囑」用 make a will。

1.translation: Many people die without leaving behind the passwords to their social media accounts, which makes it impossible for their families to retrieve their most precious memories.
1.explanation_zh: 「使家人無法找回」是前面整件事造成的結果，用 which 引導的非限定子句承接整個前句；「最珍貴的回憶」用 most precious memories，「找回」用 retrieve。

2.translation: Therefore, appointing a reliable person to manage one's digital legacy should be regarded as an indispensable part of making a will.
2.explanation_zh: 主詞是「指定一位可靠的人……」，用動名詞片語 appointing ... 當主詞；「被視為」用 be regarded as，「不可或缺的一環」用 an indispensable part of；「立遺囑」用 making a will。
